# Built by Josh Studio

> Built by Josh Studio LLC is a one-person creative studio in Kansas. It publishes Notion OS templates and Excel/Google Sheets workbooks under its Tynkr Tools & Co brand, zodiac digital art under its own name, fiction as J.S. Warden, the Nước Mắm cookbook as Josh Tran, guided print planners, and a suite of free browser tools — all built by a single founder.

Built by Josh Studio LLC (a Kansas limited liability company formed in 2026; the studio started in 2025 as a one-person practice) is the company behind everything on builtbyjoshstudio.com and its subdomains. Tynkr Tools & Co is its productivity brand: Notion templates are the creator line, Excel/Google Sheets workbooks are the consumer line, plus guided print planners, free web tools, and upcoming local-first Windows desktop apps. The zodiac art collections are published directly under the studio's own name. Under the pen name J.S. Warden, Josh writes fiction — *Overlayed Echoes* (a near-future LitRPG, Book 1 of a planned five-book series) and *Ebonspire Chronicles* (a dark fantasy detective noir; Book One is out). As Josh Tran he wrote *Nước Mắm — A Vietnamese Family Cookbook* and co-hosts the Josh & Jordan's Kitchen cooking channel on YouTube. Little Acre Learning (children's books and printables, littleacrelearning.com) is a separate brand of the same LLC.

How things are sold: every digital product is an instant download with checkout by Lemon Squeezy on this domain. The Tynkr templates, workbooks, and the cookbook are also listed on Etsy (shop: tynkrtoolsandco) as a secondary option; books and planners are on Amazon. The zodiac bundles, as packaged on this site, are sold here — the Built by Josh Studio Etsy shop (etsy.com/shop/BuiltByJoshStudio) carries individual prints and other studio work. All sales of digital goods are final (technical issues are always fixed). Every paid Tynkr template and workbook has a free Lite version. A fuller, machine-readable fact file lives at https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt.

## About, books, cookbook

- [About the studio and Josh](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/about.html): Canonical About page: the founder's background, how the studio is organized (Built by Josh Studio LLC as the company, Tynkr Tools & Co as its productivity brand, zodiac art under the studio's own name, fiction as J.S. Warden, the cookbook as Josh Tran, Little Acre Learning for kids), both YouTube channels, and how to reach the studio.
- [Books — J.S. Warden fiction and the cookbook](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/books.html): Fiction under the pen name J.S. Warden — Overlayed Echoes (near-future LitRPG, Book 1 of a planned five-book series; Kindle $5.99, paperback $12.99, hardcover $23.99, free on Kindle Unlimited; Amazon B0H3826V21) and Ebonspire Chronicles (dark fantasy detective noir, Book One; Kindle $7.99 at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H8BRT4NF, free on Kindle Unlimited, paperback $14.99, hardcover $25.99; a completely separate world from Overlayed Echoes) — plus the Nước Mắm cookbook by Josh Tran.
- [Nước Mắm — A Vietnamese Family Cookbook](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/nuoc-mam-cookbook.html): A 56-page Vietnamese family cookbook by Josh Tran (his own name, not the pen name) — fish sauce and core sauces, summer rolls, bún bowls, over-rice dishes, fried spring rolls, bánh mì, and a twelve-hour phở, balanced by tasting rather than measuring. $3.99 ebook (EPUB + PDF, instant download); also on Kindle at $3.99 (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBCXTLWD) and on Etsy at $3.99 (https://www.etsy.com/listing/4551851115/nc-mm-vietnamese-family-cookbook-o). Paperback: $7.99 on Amazon (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBL7HZYN; 80 pages, 5 x 8 in, ISBN 979-8188988173, published July 25, 2026). Companion cooking channel: Josh & Jordan's Kitchen on YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@joshandjordanskitchen).
- [Built by Josh Studio — home](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/): The studio's front door: Tynkr Tools & Co templates and workbooks, free Lite versions, the zodiac art collections, planners, books, and the cookbook.

- [Debt Snowball vs. Avalanche: Which Pays Off Faster?](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/debt-payoff-calculator.html): Snowball for momentum, avalanche for math — both debt payoff methods explained, plus a hybrid, how to choose, and why an extra payment beats either method.
- [The 50/30/20 Budget, Checked Against What You Actually Spend](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/budget-calculator.html): The 50/30/20 rule explained — what goes in each bucket, why it doesn't fit every cost of living, and the step most calculators skip: ideal vs. what you spend.
- [How to Make a Professional Invoice (Free, No Signup)](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/invoice-generator.html): What every invoice needs, how to add your letterhead, the line-item and tax math, and how to save a PDF — with a free in-browser tool that never uploads data.

Refrigerator and cold-water methods, USDA-compliant, with built-in food safety guardrails.
- [The Brine Calculator: Precise Salt Math for Wet and Dry Brining](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/brine-calculator.html): Build notes on the brine calculator: why brining math matters, what it handles — salt type, protein weight, brine strength, time — and how it fits the kit.
- [Why More Home Cooks Should Batch Broths: The Single Best Habit I've Ever Built](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/why-home-cooks-should-batch-broths.html): Why batching broth weekly pays off for a home cook: real cost and time numbers, plus the techniques that make it work — fat removal, double-strain, demi-glace.
- [The Perfect Roast Pull Temp Calculator: When to Pull Brisket, Duck & Venison Off the Heat](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/perfect-roast-pull-temp-calculator.html): Free carryover cooking calculator: the exact pull-from-heat temp for brisket, duck breast, venison, fish, and steak — resting handled. No signup, no ads.
- [The Baking Pan Swap Calculator: Why Pan Math Shouldn't Be a Guess](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/baking-pan-swap-calculator.html): Convert any recipe between pan sizes — square, round, rectangle, muffin tin, Bundt — with an instant scaling multiplier and bake-time warning. Free, no signup.
- [Cook the Way You Want to Cook: A Home Cook's Case Against Culinary Purism](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/cook-the-way-you-want-to-cook.html): A daily home cook's argument for cooking the way you want to cook. The only rules worth following are food safety and a few real technique rules. Everything else is yours.

No signup, no ads.

### Kitchen & cooking

- [Air Fryer Conversion Calculator](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/air-fryer-conversion-calculator/): Convert any oven recipe to air fryer settings — temperature, time, and when to check, tuned by food type. Fahrenheit or Celsius. Free, ad-free, no signup.
- [Brine Calculator](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/brine-calculator/): Calculate wet or dry brines for turkey, chicken, pork, and more. Get precise salt amounts, water ratios, sugar options, and brining time recommendations.
- [Cookware & Pan Guide](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/cookware-pan-guide/): Select the best cookware material and pan shape for any cooking task. Interactive advisor, material explorer, and care guidelines. Free, ad-free, local-first.
- [Cost Per Serving Calculator](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/cost-per-serving-calculator/): Calculate total recipe costs, per-serving unit economics, and waste buffer allowances. Supports dynamic ingredients, pack pricing, and automatic unit conversions.
- [Dough Hydration Calculator](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/dough-hydration-calculator/): Calculate dough hydration and baker's percentages for bread, pizza, and pasta. Get flour, water, and salt by weight with absorbency warnings. Free, ad-free.
- [Meat Thawing Planner](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/meat-thawing-planner/): Calculate safe meat thawing times for turkey, chicken, beef, and pork using USDA fridge and cold-water methods, with food-safety warnings. Free and ad-free.
- [Pan Swap Calculator](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/pan-swap-calculator/): Instantly convert cake recipes between muffin, Bundt, round, square, and rectangular pans. Get exact multipliers and bake-time warnings. Free and ad-free.
- [Perfect Roast Pull Temp](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/perfect-roast-pull-temp-calculator/): Calculate the exact temperature to pull your roast, steak, or turkey from the oven to account for carryover cooking. A free, ad-free culinary utility.
- [Recipe Nutrition Calculator](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/recipe-nutrition-calculator/): Paste ingredients to calculate per-serving calories, macronutrients, and generate an Estimated Nutrition Facts label. Free, ad-free, local-first.
- [Pork Roast Cooking Time Calculator](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/reverse-roasting-calculator/): Pork roast cooking time, worked backward from dinner — enter a pork shoulder, ham, turkey, or beef roast and serve time for an exact oven timeline. Free.
- [Universal Recipe Scaler](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/universal-recipe-scaler/): Instantly scale, multiply, or divide cooking and baking recipes. A free, local-first utility to convert portions and metric measurements with zero ads.
- [Yeast Converter](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/yeast-converter/): Convert yeast measurements between Active Dry, Instant, and Fresh yeast. Convert grams, ounces, teaspoons, and packets with automatic weight guards. Free, ad-free.

## Desktop apps — Tynkr Tools & Co (coming soon)

Four privacy-first, local-first Windows desktop apps. User data lives in flat files on the user's machine — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions. Site: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (its own index: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)

- [Tynkr Ledger — Personal Finance OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ledger/): Transactions, budgets, bills, debt payoff, and net worth on your own disk.
- [Tynkr Vault — Second Brain OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/vault/): Notes, tasks, and weekly reviews as plain Markdown files you own, with fast fuzzy search.
- [Tynkr Hearth — Homebuyer OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/hearth/): The whole home purchase, mapped — mortgage math, down payment planning, cash-to-close, roadmap, document tracker.
- [Tynkr Forge — Small Business OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/forge/): Invoicing, CRM, purchase orders, contracts, expenses with receipts, and proposals in one app.
